input.brief: A multi-threaded download engine for the JVM (Kotlin): adaptive concurrency, everything except the kernel is a plugin, embeddable as a library

direction.name: The sentence is the layout
direction.idea: One short sentence, set at poster scale, is the composition. The trick that makes it an idea rather than a big headline: something from the subject sits inside the sentence where a word would be. A strip of photograph fills the gap between two words; a small live fragment of the product replaces the noun; the object the sentence names is pictured at the size of a letter. Write the sentence first, find the word that can be shown instead of said, and put the showing in its place. The reader completes the sentence with their eyes.
direction.composition: The sentence is four to seven words and runs as one or two full-width lines at 9–13vw. Inline with the type, on the baseline, sits one media slot: a rounded-rectangle or square frame exactly one line-height tall and two to three ems wide, holding a photograph or a looping crop. Above and below the sentence the screen is empty except for a small navigation line and one supporting sentence set small, both on the same left margin. Later sections repeat the grammar at smaller scale: each is a short statement on the left six columns with its proof (image, figure, list) on the right, so the page reads as a series of sentences with evidence. Generous vertical space (160px or more) between sections.
direction.typography: Display weight with real presence (medium to bold), tracking -0.03 to -0.05em, leading 0.95–1.0 so two lines sit close. The inline frame aligns to cap height and baseline exactly; set it with em units so it scales with the type.
direction.colour: A calm ground with ink at full contrast. The only colour comes from the photograph inside the sentence; if the palette has an accent, use it once, on the action.
direction.imagery: One strong, simple photograph that reads at small size (a face, an object, a texture, a horizon), cropped to a wide strip inside the sentence. The same image may open to full width in the next section, so the small slot feels like a window onto something larger.
direction.richness: The collision of big type and one live image inside it. Because there is only one image on the first screen, choose it with care and give it perfect alignment to the letters.
direction.pitfalls: The sentence must be short enough for two lines on a phone, where the inline frame drops to its own line between the two halves. Do not style one word differently to fake the device. Do not use more than one slot per sentence.

hero.name: Headline across two fields
hero.blueprint: The viewport is two flat fields meeting at exactly half height: paper above, one saturated colour below, with a hard edge and nothing drawn on it. A two-line headline in black-weight capitals at clamp(96px, 9.5vw, 150px), line-height 0.86, is centred across the seam and spans about 70% of the width, so line one stands on the upper field and line two is cut through its upper third by the seam. The type changes ink where it crosses: above the seam it takes the accent ink, below it a deep ink two steps darker than the lower field, as if submerged. Build it as two stacked copies of the same headline, one per ink, the first clipped with `clip-path: inset(0 0 50% 0)` and the second with `inset(50% 0 0 0)`. Wordmark top-left at 28px; up to four text links and the single action, a solid rectangular button, top-right. One supporting sentence at 20px in the paper colour is centred on the lower field, 56px above the bottom edge. The lower field continues for 30svh past the fold before the next colour begins.
hero.mobile: The same two fields with the seam at 46svh. The headline stays on two lines at 15vw, centred, still cut by the seam and still changing ink. Wordmark top-left and the action button top-right; the links drop into one menu word beside it. The supporting sentence sits on the lower field at 16px, centred, max 28ch, with 40px beneath it.
hero.headline: A statement of two to four words on two lines, up to about 10 characters per line, whose meaning the rising field acts out.

type.note: A soft, low-contrast serif in a light weight, more book than fashion magazine, large and calm in sentence case. Suits outdoor and craft products, restaurants, cameras and slow consumer goods.

palette.name: Black and crimson
palette.note: Black with off-white text and mid-grey texture takes nearly the whole page, and the last sections may invert to off-white with black type. Deep crimson is scattered sparingly: a few characters in a heading, a slider fill, the one button.

motion.name: Colour by chapter
motion.description: Each chapter is its own full-bleed field of one palette colour, so the ground changes exactly at section edges as you scroll, never as a global recolouring of the screen. The only movement: the fixed header (or the one pinned element) takes the ink of the chapter beneath it, switching with a 300ms colour transition as each edge passes under it. Do not drive the page background from an observer: in blind tests a page recoloured mid-section, with a paragraph sitting on two colours, read as broken twice.

sections.name: Stages as one bar
sections.blueprint: The product's progress bar, enlarged until it spans the page, is the diagram. One bar runs across columns 1–12, 22vh tall, built as a flex row of three or four solid segments with 6px gaps, root marked data-ui. Each segment's width follows how long that stage really takes (flex-grow from the true durations, 12% minimum), and each is a different flat palette colour, so the reader sees at once that signing up is a sliver and the rest is the product working. Inside every segment, top-left with 20px padding, its duration in words at clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px): 'Two minutes', 'About a day'. Under each segment, on its left edge, one clause at 17px, 22ch wide, beginning with its order word. Above the bar, 64px clear of it, the heading: two to five words at clamp(48px, 6.4vw, 104px), flush left. Nothing else.
sections.mobile: The bar turns vertical: segments stack as full-width blocks whose heights keep the proportions, 72px minimum, 6px gaps, about 70svh in total. Each holds its duration at 22px top-left and its clause at 16px beneath. The heading sits above at 11vw on two lines.

sections.name: Names as one sentence
sections.blueprint: Client, press or partner names are written out as one run-on sentence and set large: clamp(40px, 5vw, 76px), leading 1.0, flush left across all twelve columns, wrapping naturally over five to seven lines. Names are separated by commas and the list ends with a full stop. All names are set in a dimmed ink (still at least 3:1 against the ground), so the block reads as texture; one name at a time is lit in the full ink, and the lit name moves through the list every two seconds (a class toggled by a short script, with a 400ms colour transition). The sentence opens with two or three plain words in the full ink that act as the heading: the phrase that introduces the names. Nothing else is in the section: no logos, no columns, and 120px of space above and below.
sections.mobile: The same sentence at 9vw, wrapping over ten to fourteen lines; cut the list to the twelve strongest names so it stays within one and a half screens. The lit name still cycles. Margins are 20px and there are no other elements.

sections.name: Sentences with switches
sections.blueprint: Four or five capabilities, each one plain sentence of five to eight words about what the product will do for you, each ending in a working switch. Every sentence is a full-bleed band 20vh tall, butted against the next with no gap. Inside, on the 12-column grid: the sentence at clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 60px) on one line in columns 1–10, vertically centred; in columns 11–12, right-aligned, the product's real toggle, built in em with its root marked data-ui, 1.1em tall so it matches the type. Off, a band is the page ground and its sentence is in the soft ink. On, the band fills with a palette colour, a different one per band, the sentence turns to full ink and a second line at 17px appears beneath stating the consequence in figures. Two bands are on at load. Toggles answer click, Space and Enter. There is no heading; the first sentence does that work.
sections.mobile: Bands are at least 132px tall. The sentence is set at 6.4vw on two lines in the left 76% of the width; the toggle sits at the right, vertically centred, with a 44px touch target. When a band is on, the consequence line opens under the sentence at 15px.

sections.name: Statement, table pushed right
sections.blueprint: A heading of four to six words spans the full width on two lines at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), left-aligned with its first line indented 3vw and leading 0.98. 96px below, the table is pushed into the right-hand five columns (8–12) and the left stays open. One plain word naming the table (offices, hours, rates) hangs at 14px in column 7, top-aligned with the first row. Each row is a three-part line at 15–16px with 26px between rows: the kind or day in the soft ink at the left of the measure, the place or service at 30%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. In columns 1–4, bottom-aligned with the last row, one 4:5 photograph 22vw wide may sit alone. Holds 5–14 rows.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9.5vw without the indent. The table takes the full width at 16px; each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line. The naming word is dropped because the heading already says it. The photograph follows at 60% width on the right margin.

sections.name: Wide heading, indented questions
sections.blueprint: A heading of three to five words at about 5.5vw runs from the left margin on one or two lines and is the only large thing in the section. 80px beneath it the questions begin, indented to start at column 5 and running to column 12, so the left third under the heading stays empty. Each question is a row at 22–24px in the regular weight with a chevron of two 2px strokes at the far right; rows are separated by 36px of space and no rules. Opening a row lays a tile of the one-step tone behind that row and its answer (24px padding, extending 24px beyond the text on both sides) and shows the answer at 17px with a 48ch measure. Six questions. Nothing else shares the screen; the indent against the wide heading is the composition. Build with `<details>`.
sections.mobile: The heading sits at 10vw on two lines. Questions lose the indent and run full width at 19px with 28px between rows; the open row keeps its tone tile, now bleeding to both screen edges, with the answer at 16px inside it.

sections.name: A sentence with a blank
sections.blueprint: The closing sentence has a gap in it, and the gap is the form. A sentence of five to eight words is set at about 6vw on two lines, flush left across columns 1–11; there is no separate heading. Where the reader's email (or name, or city) belongs, an `<input>` sits inline on the baseline: a filled block of the one-step tone, exactly one line-height tall and about 7em wide, with the placeholder in the same face and size in the softer ink, no border, and the page's radius or motif corner. The sentence's last word is the submit `<button>`, set in the same type on a block of the accent colour of the same height. Field and button use `em` units so they scale with the sentence. One line at 16px under the sentence, in the softer ink, says what happens after sending. Nothing else is in the section.
sections.mobile: The sentence is set at 10vw on two lines; the input drops to a line of its own between them at full width and one line-height tall, and the final word, as the button, ends the second line. The explaining line follows at 15px.

sections.name: Contact as the headline
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed field in one saturated palette colour, at least 90svh tall. Top row, 40px from the edge: two or three short notes at 15px in columns 1–7 (address, hours, a one-line description) and a back-to-top text link at the right margin. Then a tall empty gap. In the lower half, the way to get in touch is the display line: the telephone number or the email address itself, set at 8–9vw, flush left, hard against the margin, as one link. An email address may break once, before the @, giving two lines. Size it with `clamp()` so the longest line fills at least 80% of the width. Under it, one row of small text at 14px spread across three positions: links at the left, credits in the centre, city and year at the right. The wordmark appears only small, in the top row.
sections.mobile: Notes stack at the top at 15px. The contact line sits in the lower half at 12vw; a telephone number stays on one line, an email breaks before the @ and is sized so each half fits the width. The meta row becomes three stacked lines at 13px.

references.name: CoffeeTech®
references.idea: Present an industrial roaster maker like a design brand: one enormous three-word statement on black, with the machine withheld until the first scroll, where it emerges from the dark.
references.hero: Near-black viewport with nothing but type. A centred three-line headline, one word per line, in Inter Medium at about 15vw with tight tracking; the first line starts a third of the way down and the last runs to within 35px of the bottom edge, its widest word spanning roughly 70% of the width. Cream letters; no subhead, no media, no hero button. Navigation is one quiet row: logo with a terracotta mark at left, four text links centred, then a filled terracotta 'Products' button with a grid icon, an outlined contact button and a language dropdown at right. The top third stays empty.
references.type: Inter throughout at weight 500. Display lines at 216px with -0.07em tracking and leading near 0.95 against 14px body, a jump of about 15 times. Secondary headlines near 10vw, intro paragraph around 26px. Section labels are tiny and wrapped in square brackets.
references.colour: #0d0e13 #e5e2dd #f3ece2 #c8603d #262629 — Blue-black and warm putty-grey sections alternate; cream type on dark, near-black on light. Terracotta appears only on the logo mark and the primary button.
references.imagery: Studio shots of roasters: a black machine barely lit against black after the hero, then white and black machines as cut-outs on pale-grey tiles. One warm founder portrait with a signature overlapping its edge; macro bean photos in small-radius cards.
references.layout: Outer margins of about 70px. A centred type poster on top, then an offset two-column intro, then a product grid pushed into the right two-thirds with its bracketed label alone in the left third. Oversized left-flush headlines open and close the lower page.

sections.description: Warm putty-grey band entered through a hairline. A portrait about 290px wide with 8px corners sits in the left third; a scrawled signature overlaps its bottom-right corner and spills onto the background. A seven-line paragraph at about 26px, medium weight, roughly 510px wide, begins at the horizontal midpoint, followed by a small underlined text link. No heading; the right quarter and the gap between the two elements stay empty.

A headline at roughly 10vw is flush to the left edge and clipped by the right, like a slow marquee. Below, a tiny bracketed label sits alone in the left third; the right two-thirds hold a two-column grid of pale-grey tiles about 400px wide with a small radius, each with a centred machine cut-out, the model name beneath and a tiny outlined pill for its category. The grid closes with a 64px underlined 'see all' text link with an arrow.

Back to blue-black. A cream contact headline at about 10vw sits hard against the left edge, far larger than anything near it. Underneath, the terracotta logo mark is enlarged to about 140px at left; four narrow link columns in small grey text run from 28% to 85% of the width; a pill-shaped back-to-top button sits at far right, with a thin legal row at the bottom.

steal: Let a three-word headline at about 15vw be the entire first viewport and withhold the product until the first scroll.
Photograph a dark product on a background matching the page colour so it appears to emerge from the page rather than sit in a box.
Overlap a handwritten signature onto the corner of a portrait so an about block feels signed rather than laid out.

references.name: Midnight
references.idea: The headline's circles are literally pictured: one blurred dark ring, sliced into horizontal bands, becomes the hero, the demo panel, the session cards and the footer.
references.hero: No navigation at all. A canvas fills the full width and the top 90% of the viewport: a huge out-of-focus dark navy ring on drifting taupe, sage and terracotta, cut into horizontal bands about 78px tall that are slightly offset like blinds. On the vertical centre line, starting 58px from the left, sit a small rounded-square line icon and a one-line headline at 48px in cream. On the same baseline, starting 59% across, a two-line 17px statement whose first sentence is white and bold while the rest drops to half opacity. The cream page background shows as a 90px strip at the bottom. No button.
references.type: Public Sans only, weight 500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 48px, mid-page statement about 38px on five centred lines, body 13–17px. Signature device: within one paragraph the first sentence is full strength and the remainder faded, replacing the usual heading-plus-subhead pair.
references.colour: #f4efe6 #07172a #867768 #687674 #a8735c #faf7f1 — Warm cream pages against midnight navy; the gradient mixes muted taupe, sage and terracotta around the dark ring. A peach-cream fills the small pill button. No bright accent anywhere.
references.imagery: An animated blurred ring gradient with band displacement and fine grain, used full-bleed in hero and footer, inset with 8px corners as the demo panel, and miniaturised onto three portrait session cards. No photos or UI screenshots.
references.layout: 30px side margins. Sections alternate between full-bleed gradient and cream type-only screens. Section headers split into left title and right small paragraph. Text blocks are short and often occupy one half of the width, leaving the other empty (the FAQ sits entirely in the right half).

sections.description: A full cream viewport with one centred paragraph of five lines at roughly 38px, about 820px wide. Only the opening sentence is dark; the remaining words are pale and darken progressively with scroll. Later, three small portrait cards, each about 115×180px with a mini gradient, a date at the top and a two-line label bottom-left, fan across the right side of the text, overlapping it with a soft shadow.

Header row: a two-line title at 34px on the left, a three-line 12px grey paragraph in the last fifth on the right. Below, a gradient panel spans the full content width, about 650px tall with 8px corners, holding a centred question at 34px in cream, a one-line caption, and an email capsule with an inline peach button; a small play capsule sits centred near its bottom edge.

A left-aligned two-line lead uses the dark-then-faded sentence device. Under it a two-by-two arrangement with no cards or borders, columns starting at 0 and 50%: each item is a 24px pale rounded-square icon, a quoted question as a 13px semibold title, then three or four lines of grey 12px text about 300px wide. A waitlist capsule floats fixed at bottom centre.

FAQ rows with hairlines and chevrons occupy only the right half of the screen above. The footer is the gradient again, full-bleed and about 190px tall: a two-line cream statement at left, an email capsule with inline button at right on the same line, and a row of tiny grey legal links along the bottom.

steal: Slice a soft blurred gradient into horizontal bands with small offsets so a familiar glow becomes a recognisable, ownable texture.
Replace heading-plus-subhead with one paragraph whose first sentence is full contrast and the rest half opacity.
Remove the nav from the hero entirely and put headline left and supporting line right on one shared baseline at mid-height.

references.name: Made With Gsap
references.idea: The hero is the product: a draggable vertical reel of effect demos runs through the middle of the headline, which is split and pushed to both edges to make room.
references.hero: White viewport. A one-line headline at 3.3vw is broken in two: the first half flush to the left margin, the second flush to the right, both on the vertical centre line. Between them a black rounded video card, 35% of the width and 16:9, sits dead centre with a mono catalogue number under its left corner; the cards before and after it peek in from the top and bottom edges. Wordmark top-left; top-right a grey capsule of mono uppercase links with a count chip, a round account button and a lime capsule button. Bottom-left a two-line 18px statement; bottom-right a grey mono drag hint.
references.type: LayGrotesk medium, tracking −0.02em, sentence case, for headlines (47px in the hero, about 5.5vw mid-page, 17vw in the closing banner) and 22px body; PP Neue Montreal Mono uppercase at 12px for nav, buttons and labels. Statements emphasise by grey-versus-white words.
references.colour: #ffffff #0a0a0b #c9fe6e #f1f1f1 #8a8a8a #1f6bff — White hero and footer bracket a long near-black middle; acid lime is reserved for join buttons and a tiny arrow, with one blue button inside the product UI. Demo thumbnails add saturated orange and teal.
references.imagery: Looping recordings of the effects: black 16:9 cards with 4px corners holding clusters of small saturated photo tiles (portraits on orange, water, flowers, architecture). Product UI appears inside a large white rounded panel.
references.layout: 24px margins, with text pinned to edges and centre rather than a column grid. White hero, then black full-viewport screens each holding one idea (statement, UI panel, logo strip, big number line), then a white rounded sheet rising over black as the footer.

sections.description: Black section. A mono eyebrow with a bullet dot is centred at the top; under it a three-line centred statement at about 2.6vw where most words are mid-grey and three key phrases are white. A two-line grey caption at 14px follows. Below, a white panel with 16px radius, 80% of the width, slides up from the bottom and contains a dark app window: effect preview at left, a methods list sidebar at right.

A row of seven overlapping circular avatars is centred, with a two-line mono uppercase caption beneath, then 60px lower a single line of white client logos runs edge to edge and is cropped at both sides as a marquee. Nothing else shares the black screen; the block sits in the lower half with a large empty area above it.

A full black viewport with one two-line statement centred at roughly 5.5vw, medium weight, tight leading: the count of effects, then the release cadence. Letters arrive individually, so mid-scroll the words are missing characters. A small dark capsule in the bottom-right corner shows which demo number is on screen, with a lime dot.

A white sheet with rounded top corners, inset 4px in the black page. The closing line is set at 17vw, centred, so large its first row is cut by the top edge; two capsule buttons (lime primary, grey secondary) sit centred beneath. The footer proper is one row: a newsletter heading and capsule input with inline submit on the left 40%, three small mono link columns on the right, and a legal line at the very bottom.

steal: Split a single-line headline in two and pin the halves to the left and right edges so the media sits inside the sentence.
Make the hero media a reel whose previous and next items peek from the top and bottom edges, signalling drag without arrows.
End on a white rounded sheet rising over a black page, with the final call set so large it is cropped by the sheet's top edge.
